metadata.system_prompt:
Classify this support ticket into exactly one category.

Categories: billing, account, integration, feature, bug, other

Reply with exactly one word from that list and nothing else.

results.prompt: I've been trying to reset my password for twenty minutes. The reset email never arrives. I've checked spam.
Can you add a dark mode? Staring at this all day is rough.
Clicking "Save" on the settings page does nothing. No error, no confirmation, nothing happens.
Someone on my team can still access the workspace after I removed them.
Your API rate limit documentation says 100/min but we're getting throttled at around 60.
The mobile app crashes when I open a record with more than about 50 attachments.
Can we get SSO with Okta? Our security team is asking.
My profile picture won't update. Upload seems to succeed but the old one stays.
Timestamps display in UTC regardless of what I set in preferences.
We need a way to tag records with multiple categories. Right now it's one per record.
Undo doesn't work after a bulk edit. Loses everything.
The Slack integration posts to the wrong channel after we renamed it.
Report totals don't match what's on screen. Off by a few percent, varies.
Is there an educational discount? I teach at a university.
Locked out after too many failed attempts. How long until it resets?
Attachments over 10MB fail silently. No error message, file just isn't there.
Would love to see keyboard shortcuts for the common actions.
The print layout cuts off the right side of wide tables.
Invited a colleague three days ago, they never got the email.
Bulk import failed at row 2300 of 5000 and didn't tell me which rows succeeded.
